en.body:

zh.heading: 與原始完整設計的差距
zh.body:
下列仍屬後續開發，不代表 v0.1 已完成：

- [ ] 真正的三維懸吊、路緣動態、重量轉移與胎溫抓地模型
- [ ] 獨立變速箱、手動換檔及引擎動力曲線調校
- [ ] 排位、錦標賽與完整生涯解鎖
- [ ] 正式進站車道、AI 進站策略、複合胎與維修規則
- [ ] 完整旗號、搶跑、車損退賽及比賽處罰
- [ ] 動態天候與乾燥路線
- [ ] 高擬真美術、完整回放及工程師語音
- [ ] 原生桌面包裝、方向盤與力回饋

en.heading: Gaps against the original full design
en.body:
These remain future work, not completed v0.1 features:

- [ ] Full three-dimensional suspension, kerb dynamics, weight transfer and temperature-dependent tyre grip
- [ ] Independent transmission, manual shifting and engine torque-curve tuning
- [ ] Qualifying, championship and full career unlocks
- [ ] Formal pit lanes, AI pit strategy, tyre compounds and service rules
- [ ] Complete flags, false starts, damage retirement and race penalties
- [ ] Dynamic weather and drying lines
- [ ] High-fidelity art, full replay and engineer voice
- [ ] Native desktop packaging, steering wheels and force feedback

zh.heading: 執行原則
zh.body: 每階段區分已實作、已驗證及未測項目。先驗證手感與完整比賽流程，再投入高成本美術。此版本不聲稱已達到最初完整設計的全部功能。

en.heading: Working principles
en.body: Distinguish implemented, verified and untested items at every stage. Validate handling and full race flows before investing in costly art. This release does not claim to implement the entire original design.
